semantic_review.core_reader_question: Why can pneumonia symptoms improve while a loculated effusion enlarges, and which independent evidence warrants aspiration, exudate classification, or drainage?
semantic_review.new_understanding: Real 56M Day3/Day5 observations + pre-sampling antibiotics; Light's classification vs BTS nonpurulent infection decision vs safe procedural window; case action not guideline or efficacy proof.
semantic_review.strongest_counterargument: A single Cureus case cannot establish drainage or tPA/DNase efficacy; Day5 pH7.42 and culture negativity after antibiotics do not yield a universal drainage rule. The BTS 2023 original Appendix1 p5 has been independently visually checked, including high-pH septation footnote and LDH >=900 flowchart versus >900 table.
